name: web-sky-blue-liquid-supplement-landing-page-long
title: Sky-Blue Liquid Supplement Landing Page
whatItIs: A tall e-commerce landing page with a cloudy sky hero, a serif headline with inline pill icons, a carousel of tilted lifestyle photo cards, ticker bar, benefit sections with script annotations, product cards in pastel tints, a social gallery and a navy footer with giant brand name.
whatItMeans: Sky, clouds and juicy fruit photography convey freshness and lightness, and the handwritten orange notes add personality.
techniques: Inline product and pill icons inside serif headlines
Tilted photo card carousel under the hero
Announcement ticker at the top and giant footer wordmark

vocabulary.definition: An icon or image placed within a line of headline text.
A handwritten-style note added next to a heading.
A scrolling strip of offers at the top of a site.
